description: Generate attendance summary and manager note suggestion

steps.description: Generate attendance summary using Izzara persona
steps.prompt_template:
Attendance record:
Employee: {{employee_name}} ({{employee_id}})
Action: {{action}}
{{#if notes}}Notes: {{notes}}{{/if}}

Generate:
1. A short attendance summary sentence
2. Optional manager note suggestion (how to respond/encourage if needed)

Use supportive, HR-friendly tone. No policy enforcement, just soft narrative.
